items.title: 'All coming together' - Isak repaying Liverpool faith
items.description: Alexander Isak's two goals against Club Brugge take his tally for the season to 10 as the striker continues to show why Liverpool last year paid £125m to bring him to the club.
items.excerpt: Liverpool fans have needed to be patient to see the best of Alexander Isak after an injury-hit start to his career, but the striker is now proving the wait has been worth it. By scoring twice against Club Brugge in the Champions League, Isak took his tally for the season to 10 - more than double his total for his first season at the Reds. Of course, that campaign was disrupted; he had no pre-season because of his protracted £125m move from Newcastle and then suffered a broken leg in December. But Isak is now in a hot streak of form, having scored four goals in his past four games for Liverpool

In parallelo ha chiuso rinnovi importanti come Pulisic (da 3,5 a 5 milioni netti) e Pavlovic (da 1,7 a 3 milioni) mentre si lavora su Rabiot. items.excerpt: Le PSG a perdu ses premiers points de la saison sur la scène européenne. Jusqu'ici auteur de quatre victoires en quatre journées, le club de la capitale a concédé le match nul sur la pelouse du Parc des Princes mercredi face à l'AS Roma en Ligue des champions (2-2). Hasard (ou pas), ce premier coup de frein intervient juste après la grave blessure de Désiré Doué. Victime d'une rupture du ligament croisé, l'international français va manquer plusieurs mois de compétition, tout comme Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, touché par la même blessure il y a quelques semaines. items.title: Sem Westerveld, una historia muy especial en la portería del Real Zaragoza
items.description: El Real Zaragoza progresa en todas las líneas y en su camino ha encontrado un portero prometedor, al guardián de sus redes. Sem Westerveld protagoniza una evolución sostenida y se sitúa hoy en la cima de Primera RFEF.
items.excerpt: El Real Zaragoza progresa en todas las líneas y en su camino ha encontrado un portero prometedor, al guardián de sus redes. Sem Westerveld protagoniza una evolución sostenida y se sitúa hoy en la cima de Primera RFEF. Entre sus números destaca un registro incontestable: acumula ocho porterías a cero en los trece primeros partidos del curso. Cada vez más sólido en el juego y ya integrado en su nuevo ecosistema, Westerveld ha encajado solo once goles en Zaragoza. La historia de Sem Westerveld está ligada a una posición, a una herencia genética. Su padre se hizo célebre en el Liverpool de Gérard

items.title: Neville, Carragher and the inescapable podcasting feedback loop of doom | Jonathan Liew
items.description: Even the best managers can struggle to escape ex-players’ need to manufacture a crisis for content. Enter Michael Carrick … A podcast studio in Manchester. A production runner pours water into jugs. Gary Neville enters the room with Michael Carrick. Neville: Just so you know, we’re already filming. This is the intro bit, where we show everyone coming on to set and doing some light banter. It humanises us. The viewer sees it and thinks we’re just mates chatting about football, rather than scions of a global podcast empire commercially obliged to produce an endless scroll of provocative content

items.title: Hundred adds semi-finals from 2027
items.description: An extra match will be added to The Hundred for the first time in 2027 with the introduction of four-team semi-finals.
items.excerpt: An extra match will be added to The Hundred for the first time in 2027 with the introduction of semi-finals. In the previous six editions of The Hundred, only the top three qualified from the eight-team group stage. First place went straight to the final, with second and third playing in the eliminator. Now, the top four will play in traditional semis in a move designed to increase the competitiveness of the group stage and create an extra marquee fixture. The Hundred window will not be expanded to accommodate the semi-finals – the competition will still be completed in just under four weeks.

items.description: Mehran Khan amazed sports fans around the world when he caught a cricket ball while sitting on the back of a moving motorcycle.
items.excerpt: "I told my friend riding the motorcycle to duck his head. I'm going to catch it." These are the words of Mehran Khan, who amazed sports fans around the world when he caught a cricket ball while sitting on the back of a moving motorcycle. Mehran was passing a match in the Swat Premier League in Mingora when a ball sailed out of the ground towards him, with the passenger reaching out to catch it one-handed. Orphelin de Khvicha Kvaratskhelia et Désiré Doué, blessés pour de longs mois, le PSG s'est heurté à la Roma (2-2), ce mercredi, pour son premier match sans victoire cette saison en Ligue des champions. Malgré ce nul, Paris reste dans le peloton de tête de la phase de ligue: deuxième à deux points du Real Madrid, et a encore toutes ses chances de se hisser directement en huitièmes de finale avant les trois derniers matchs (Aston Villa, Côme, Galatasaray). items.description: Après six matchs sans victoire en Ligue 1, Filipe Luis et ses hommes défient, à Édimbourg, le Heart of Midlothian. Avec son nom hérité d’un roman et son stade atypique, le troisième club écossais, dans l’ombre du Celtic et des Rangers, vient de gagner 8-0 en championnat.
items.excerpt: Installé à Édimbourg, le Heart of Midlothian évolue dans l'ombre des deux géants de Glasgow, le Celtic et les Rangers. Son palmarès témoigne pourtant de ses grandes heures, avec quatre championnats d'Écosse (1895, 1897, 1958 et 1960), huit Coupes d'Écosse, dont la dernière en 2012, et quatre Coupes de la Ligue. Mal en point après trois défaites consécutives, le club a retrouvé des couleurs samedi en s'imposant 8-0 sur la pelouse du Dundee FC. L'allenatore del Psg, dopo il pari del Parco dei Principi, è sincero, molto sincero, quando dice: "La Roma è da scudetto e a me piacerebbe che lo vincesse. Poi sì, ci sono Lazio, Inter, Como e Milan ma sì, vorrei che vincesse la Roma. E non mi stupirebbe. Spero entri tra le prime 24 della Champions. Non vorrei incontrarla di nuovo se non in finale. Ci metterei la firma". Gasperini pure, ovviamente. Accedi o registrati per dire la tua sugli argomenti che più ti interessano e vivere tutti i servizi di Corriere dello Sport–STADIO".
